name: Buide mac Báin
text: Buide mac Báin figures inside the Táin Bó Cuailnge, the Cattle Raid of Cooley. Early in that epic he is the one driving the bull Donn Bui Cuailnge. Cúchulainn kills him in the fight, yet the animal still escapes. Buide counts as the son of Bán Blai, whom some copies name Benblai. A few accounts give Buide the title of fool. The term buide may link to a word meaning yellow, grateful, or foolish.

okr.objective: Describe Buide mac Báin, the son of Bán Blai in the Táin killed by Cúchulainn.
key_results: He drives the bull Donn Cuailnge.
He is the son of Bán Blai, called Benblai and Buie.
